_comment: 5 mythic-tier items. Drop exclusively from the Pinnacle (Echo floor 5). Per spec §4.4, Mythic is the top rarity. Each entry has fixed affixes, flavor text, and 3 bonus sockets baked in (the spec target — every Mythic is a chase). Names + flavor tie back to the Pinnacle's identity (echo-shards, broken oaths, the Wyrd-thread). ilvl 30 across the board so they only roll from the Pinnacle's 20+tier monsterLevel.

mythics.name: Pinnacle Shard
mythics.flavor: A splinter of the boss's halo. It hums when the bell rings.

mythics.name: Broken Oath
mythics.flavor: What the Pact-Bearer swore. What the Pinnacle remembers.

mythics.name: The Echo-Thread
mythics.flavor: Stitched from the resonance. It hums against the skin of anyone with a name to lose.

mythics.name: Helm of the Pinnacle
mythics.flavor: Worn once. Worn forever. Worn through every echo.

mythics.name: Wyrdblade
mythics.flavor: The relic the deeper catacombs whispered of, finally answered.
